models.notes: Owner-approved replacement (2026-11-19) for the deprecated gemini-2.5-flash. Stable model code per https://aistudio.google.com/docs/models/gemini-3.5-flash-lite (no dated variants listed; structured outputs and thinking supported; 1,048,576 input / 65,536 output tokens). Adapter uses generateContent (legacy, 'fully supported'; Google recommends the Interactions API for new projects). temperature is NOT sent (deprecated/ignored for Gemini 3.x, HTTP 400 planned) so Gemini output cannot be pinned to deterministic sampling. Thinking: thinkingConfig.thinkingLevel MINIMAL (documented default for Flash-Lite; cannot be fully disabled; thinking tokens billed as output and bounded by maxOutputTokens). Structured output: responseMimeType application/json + responseJsonSchema (listed in the reference; behaviour unverified until the smoke test). Served model read from response modelVersion (field documented; exact string for this model unverified until the smoke test).

Mistral Small 4 (v26.03, Apache 2.0, 256k context, Structured Outputs listed). The page shows $0.15 and $0.60 without labelling input vs output, so budgeting charges BOTH tokens at $0.60 until verified. Served-model string returned by the API is unverified (smoke test).
